title: Cleanup: remove dead suppress_jump_impulse field/branch (post-DD-008)
description: After DD-008 removed the flight toggle-out path, the one-shot suppress_jump_impulse flag is dead code: nothing sets it true anymore, so the skip-impulse branch in JumpState.enter() is unreachable and the else-branch always runs. Remove the field from scripts/player/player.gd and test/helpers/fake_player.gd, delete the dead branch in scripts/fsm/states/jump_state.gd (keep the impulse + register_jump path), and drop any now-obsolete test referencing it. Verify GUT stays green headless (no cd; absolute --path).
acceptance_criteria: suppress_jump_impulse is removed from player.gd and fake_player.gd and the unreachable branch in jump_state.gd is deleted, with the normal jump impulse + register_jump path preserved.
No remaining references to suppress_jump_impulse anywhere in the tree.
Full GUT suite still passes headless (exit 0) and the project loads with zero parse errors.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Subsumed by TASK-012 (combat polish), which includes the suppress_jump_impulse dead-code cleanup as item 1 alongside two fairness fixes. Tracking the work there.
